_doc: Race tyres for Track Mode (scripts/vehicle/physics/race_sim.gd). grip: x the car's own tyre at its best (the window); window: [lo, hi] surface temperature (C) where it's at its best; cold: its grip at 20 C, x grip (a cold slick: about 15-20 % down); hot: lost per 10 C past the window's top; wear: x the base wear rate (the soft wears fastest); heat: x the base heating (the soft comes in quickest); wet: x grip on a wet track (a slick aquaplanes, a wet tyre bites); dry_wear: a wet tyre on a dry track wears and overheats this much faster. Figures in the range Pirelli and Michelin publish for GT3 slicks (an optimal window roughly 80-110 C; cold pressure ~1.35-1.45 bar, hot ~1.9-2.0 bar); the rest are the game's, balanced so a soft is a few tenths a lap quicker and lasts about half as long as a hard.
